exposure: timing of maternal hypothyroidism diagnosis (before vs during pregnancy)
cohort: 638 pregnant women with hypothyroidism who delivered live births at the Aga Khan University Hospital between 2008 and 2016.
finding: Neonatal jaundice (37.6%) and the need for intensive care unit admission (15%) were relatively common, while neonatal death was rare, and cardiovascular defects were the most common clinically significant congenital anomaly observed.
birth_weight: low birth weight was assessed as an outcome
